title: One Pixel
description: A radical minimalist resource pack that replaces most Minecraft textures with a single solid color sampled from their top-left pixel.
body:
### **One Pixel** 
Is a unique and radical resource pack that transforms the world of Minecraft into an absolute triumph of minimalist design. If you are tired of complex details or looking for a truly fresh visual experience, this pack is for you.

### **💡 How does it work?**
The concept is simple yet mind-blowing: every single texture in the game—from a basic dirt block to complex item sprites—is reduced to a single solid color. This color is sampled directly from the top-left pixel of the original texture. No noise, no gradients, just pure color.

### **✨ Features:**
Ultimate Minimalism: The entire world turns into a stylish, low-poly abstract masterpiece.

A New Perspective on Building: Familiar structures will look completely different. It’s all about shape and color palette now.

### **🛠 Installation:**
Download the .zip archive.

Launch Minecraft and go to Options -> Resource Packs.

Click Open Pack Folder and drop the downloaded file there.

Select the pack from the list and click Done.

### ❗Exceptions:
**Grass block** - its texture has not been completely replaced for unknown reasons.
**Ore blocks** - the color of their texture is a mixture of stone/deepslate color and ore color
